brief: CardVertical needs two new overlay actions on its thumbnail: a favorite toggle and an overflow menu. A card shows one of them or neither, never both. Some pages also need consumer-specific content in the card, such as an instructor row or a grouped "New · Updated this week" meta line, while most pages keep using today's simple card. How should CardVertical change?
notes: The brief is ADR-023's own Context, rephrased. Every ADR line naming CardVertical is redacted, so the general parts rule stays but the worked example goes.
